== Course of events ==

After crossing a boggy, marshy region and passing through a large, ancient forest, Dorothy and her companions had been directed south to the Castle of Glinda by a farmer's wife who fed them a large meal along the way. At the castle gates, girl soldiers in red-and-gold uniforms questioned Dorothy before agreeing to announce her to Glinda. Following this introduction, Glinda agreed to receive Dorothy and her companions at once, granting them swift entry into her presence.

This prompt reception meant the travelers were not kept waiting at the gates, allowing their audience with Glinda to proceed without delay. It set the travelers on the path that would carry them onward through the Quadling Country and toward the rocky hill guarded by the Hammer-Heads.
